        </style><script>
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
                const episodeItems = document.querySelectorAll(".episode-item");
                const pageSelector = document.getElementById("pageSelector");
                const searchInput = document.getElementById("episodeSearch");

                function updatePagination() {
                    const selectedPage = parseInt(pageSelector.value, 10);
                    const start = (12 - selectedPage) * 100;
                    const end = start + 100;

                    episodeItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                        if (index >= start && index < end) {
                            item.style.display = "flex";
                        } else {
                            item.style.display = "none";
                        }
                    });
                }

                function applySearch() {
                    const searchValue = searchInput.value.trim();
                    if (searchValue === "") {
                        updatePagination(); // If search is empty, show the paginated results
                    } else {
                        episodeItems.forEach(item => {
                            const episodeText = item.dataset.episodeNumber; // Use dataset for numeric comparison
                            if (episodeText === searchValue) {
                                item.style.display = "flex"; // Show only exact matches
                            } else {
                                item.style.display = "none";
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

                searchInput.addEventListener("input", applySearch);
                pageSelector.addEventListener("change", updatePagination);
                updatePagination(); // Trigger initial pagination
            });
        </script><div class="search-container">
                <select id="pageSelector"><option value="12">Page 12</option><option value="11">Page 11</option><option value="10">Page 10</option><option value="9">Page 9</option><option value="8">Page 8</option><option value="7">Page 7</option><option value="6">Page 6</option><option value="5">Page 5</option><option value="4">Page 4</option><option value="3">Page 3</option><option value="2">Page 2</option><option value="1">Page 1</option></select>
                <input type="text" id="episodeSearch" placeholder="Find episode number exactly" />
            </div><div class="episodes-container"><div style="display: none;" class="episode-item" data-episode-number="1123">

jQuery("#thememode input[type='checkbox']").on('change', function(){
	var is_on = jQuery("#thememode input[type='checkbox']").prop("checked");
	if (is_on == false){
		if (dmlogo2) {
			jQuery(".logos img").attr('src', dmlogo2);
			//jQuery(".footer-logo img").attr('src', dmlogo2);
		}
		localStorage.setItem("thememode", "lightmode");
		jQuery("body").addClass("lightmode");
		jQuery("body").removeClass("darkmode");
		
	}else{
		if (dmlogo1) {
			jQuery(".logos img").attr('src', dmlogo1);
			//jQuery(".footer-logo img").attr('src', dmlogo1);
		}
		localStorage.setItem("thememode", "darkmode");
		jQuery("body").removeClass("lightmode");
		jQuery("body").addClass("darkmode");
	}
	updateFooterLogo();
});
